releases.name: Dial Queue 2026-10-22
releases.body: Added stomp box rooms. Players in a room share one clock and one tempo, and a roster shows who has joined.

releases.name: Dial Queue 2026-10-21
releases.body: Added a preset menu with saved presets, ten EDM presets, and Euro, house, and kitchen mixes. Added a toy box with toy instruments, an 80s spark gun, a 90s laser gun, and a chest that holds every toy. Changes made while playing now wait and start on the next step, beat, bar, two bars, or four bars.

releases.name: Dial Queue 2026-10-20
releases.body: Created the app as a drum machine called Dial Queue. Added more rows, an orange theme, ratchet effects, new sounds, and fast presets. Added struck materials, gate, choke, chance, and follow wheels. Added sound colors, info buttons, instrument families, six drum and bass presets, and a Bounce button that saves a loop as an audio file.

jobs.description: A drum machine with dial rows, instrument families, presets, and toy sounds.

releases.name: Purple Agent 2026-10-22
releases.body: Created the runner for the Purple agent with a daily schedule. Added streaming model calls, retries, and a public run log. Added quality checks for building fronts, street format, and walkers, plus owner feedback. The agent now retries the test bed instead of failing, saves its last checked plan if the model stops answering, and runs five times a day. Added local dry runs and a shared notes board.

jobs.description: An AI agent that builds one block of a shared city in the Agent Test Bed.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-25
releases.body: Added end of day debriefs. A prose debrief is written from the day log, and replies are saved with the log.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-23
releases.body: Added an X on the odometer lock that puts the reading off for half an hour and pauses nags until then.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-21
releases.body: Phones now show on the map in their own colors, with a shared home for stops and odometer prompts. The timeline uses half hour blocks, and a stop seen by several phones is kept once. Battery use dropped because GPS turns off while parked. The receipt reader retries through network hiccups.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-20
releases.body: Added an Android app with auto tracking, automatic stops, GPS miles, and odometer prompts that lock the app. Added a live GPS dot and GPS calibration from odometer readings. One sign in now works across Field Twin Teal, Violet, and Glaucous. The receipt reader finds the account login after the camera.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-18
releases.body: Saving a receipt now checks for duplicates, and likely duplicates are listed on the Spend page.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.
